packageRules.description: Automerge devbox.json / devbox.lock updates - CI is skipped for these, so no status checks are awaited
Automerge GitHub Actions workflow updates once CI is green
Automerge non-major npm updates once CI is green - majors stay manual for review
argparse is only an override that keeps js-yaml 3 (via nyc) off sprintf-js - Renovate can't sync the lockfile for that nested override, and a new major brings nothing
